blocks.text: The retry budget of component Q001 is 67 messages. It is documented here because several teams depend on it. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart.
The retry budget of component X002 is 16 minutes. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
The retry budget of component Z003 is 37 seconds. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The cache ttl of component W004 is 37 megabytes. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
Figure 2: Leakage before and after the fix.
